data.summary:
**When:** [Your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), at its [Battle-shock step](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock-step), before a **[battle-shock roll](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)** is made for a unit of yours.

**Target:** That unit.

**Effect:** The roll succeeds without being made.

**Restrictions:** This Stratagem can be used only once per battle.
